groups.title: gRPC and Protocol Buffers
groups.question: Explain how gRPC and Protocol Buffers work for service-to-service calls, and how the contract evolves over time.

followUps.Protocol Buffers Schema Design: Why is reusing or renumbering a protobuf field tag dangerous for clients that have not redeployed?
followUps.gRPC Streaming Patterns: When would you choose a streaming RPC over a unary one, and what new problem does streaming bring?

groups.title: Resilience Patterns
groups.question: Explain how a service should call other services so that failures do not spread.

followUps.Timeouts, Retries, and Idempotency: Why can retrying a failed call without an idempotency key be worse than the original failure?
followUps.Service Discovery: What problem does service discovery solve in a container environment where IPs keep changing?

groups.title: REST Communication
groups.question: Explain how you choose an API style between services and how you make sure an API change does not break its callers.

followUps.REST vs gRPC Trade-offs: When would you pick gRPC over REST, and when would REST be the better choice?
followUps.Contract Testing with Pact: How does consumer-driven contract testing catch a breaking change before deployment?

groups.title: Connection Management
groups.question: Explain how services keep calls to each other fast and keep APIs compatible across many deploys.

followUps.Connection Pooling and Keep-Alive: What goes wrong when a connection pool is sized too small, and what goes wrong when it is too large?
followUps.Backward-Compatible API Evolution: How do you safely remove a field from an API that other teams still call?
